readme: Everything HexGate draws, as data: settings, formulas, sprite recipes and baked images.
settings: key "group.name" -> value (float or [r, g, b, a] 0..255), range, hint and what must be rebuilt when it changes.
camera / world / draw: the algorithms in words and formulas, in the order the renderer uses them.
sprites: recipe of every sprite kind (ids are used everywhere), quantisation, and an atlas PNG (straight alpha).
screen_layers: background and vignette recipes with 1280x720 images; disc = spark texture.
game: rules, difficulty and quality tables, HUD layout (u = height / 100) and palette.
reference_frame: one CPU-rendered frame with its camera state.
Images: PNG, base64 encoded. Colours: [r, g, b, a] 0..255. Angles in the settings are degrees.
Units: world unit = hexagon radius (hexagon_field.hex_radius); screen = pixels of the render size (window x graphics quality).

conventions.world: x right, y down, z forward; the camera flies toward +z
conventions.screen: pixels, origin top-left, pixel centres at integer + 0.5
conventions.angles: degrees in settings, radians in formulas (rad(x))

camera.speed.name: Speed
camera.speed.hint: Forward speed, world units per second (hex radius = 1 unit by default).

camera.look_freq.name: Look freq
camera.look_freq.hint: Speed of the automatic look-around and roll, cycles per second.

camera.mouse_smooth.name: Mouse smooth
camera.mouse_smooth.hint: How fast the camera follows the mouse (1/s).

camera.near_clip.name: Near clip
camera.near_clip.hint: Nothing closer than this is drawn, units.

camera.far_clip.name: Far clip
camera.far_clip.hint: View distance, units. Larger = more hexagons to draw.

camera.mouse_steer.name: Mouse steer
camera.mouse_steer.hint: How far the mouse turns the camera, degrees.

depth_of_field.focus_distance.name: Focus distance
depth_of_field.focus_distance.hint: Distance of the sharp plane, units.

depth_of_field.aperture.name: Aperture
depth_of_field.aperture.hint: Blur strength. CoC px = Aperture x H / 100 x |z - focus| / z.

depth_of_field.max_blur.name: Max blur
depth_of_field.max_blur.hint: Largest blur radius, px per 1000 px of output height.

fog.fog_start.name: Fog start
fog.fog_start.hint: Distance where hexagons start to fade, units.

fog.fog_end.name: Fog end
fog.fog_end.hint: Distance where they are gone, units.

fog.near_fade_start.name: Near fade start
fog.near_fade_start.hint: Hexagons closer than this start to fade out, units.

fog.near_fade_end.name: Near fade end
fog.near_fade_end.hint: Hexagons closer than this are invisible, units.

hexagon_field.sheet_gap.name: Sheet gap
hexagon_field.sheet_gap.hint: Distance between honeycomb sheets along the flight path, units.

hexagon_field.z_jitter.name: Z jitter
hexagon_field.z_jitter.hint: Random depth offset of each cell, x sheet gap.

hexagon_field.thickness.name: Thickness
hexagon_field.thickness.hint: Prism depth (front to back face), units.

hexagon_field.layout_distance.name: Layout distance
hexagon_field.layout_distance.hint: Distance at which the diagonal mask matches the screen, units.

hexagon_field.edge_slope.name: Edge slope
hexagon_field.edge_slope.hint: Slope of the empty-area edge (screen heights per screen height).

hexagon_field.edge_offset.name: Edge offset
hexagon_field.edge_offset.hint: Moves the edge down (+) or up (-), screen heights.

hexagon_field.fade_start.name: Fade start
hexagon_field.fade_start.hint: Distance from the edge where cells start (negative = into the empty side).

hexagon_field.fade_end.name: Fade end
hexagon_field.fade_end.hint: Distance from the edge where the field is full.

hexagon_field.density.name: Density
hexagon_field.density.hint: Chance a cell inside the field holds a hexagon.

hexagon_field.cluster_high.name: Cluster high
hexagon_field.cluster_high.hint: Noise value where clusters are full.

hexagon_field.loose_chance.name: Loose chance
hexagon_field.loose_chance.hint: Chance an empty cell near the edge spawns a stray hexagon.

hexagon_field.loose_zone.name: Loose zone
hexagon_field.loose_zone.hint: Width of the zone where strays appear (screen heights).

hexagon_field.loose_drift.name: Loose drift
hexagon_field.loose_drift.hint: How far strays drift into the empty side (x hex radius).

hexagon_style.line_width.name: Line width
hexagon_style.line_width.hint: Rim width x on-screen hex radius (min 1 px).

hexagon_style.face_alpha.name: Face alpha
hexagon_style.face_alpha.hint: 0..255 - how much the face hides what is behind it.

hexagon_style.back_alpha.name: Back alpha
hexagon_style.back_alpha.hint: Back face alpha x rim alpha.

hexagon_style.inner_size.name: Inner size
hexagon_style.inner_size.hint: Inner rim size relative to the face.

hexagon_style.inner_alpha.name: Inner alpha
hexagon_style.inner_alpha.hint: Inner rim alpha x rim alpha.

hexagon_style.side_alpha.name: Side alpha
hexagon_style.side_alpha.hint: Side edges alpha x rim alpha.

hexagon_style.side_max_blur.name: Side max blur
hexagon_style.side_max_blur.hint: Side edges are drawn only below this blur (px per 1000 px height).

glow.glow_width.name: Glow width
glow.glow_width.hint: Halo stroke width x rim width.

glow.glow_blur.name: Glow blur
glow.glow_blur.hint: Halo blur radius x on-screen hex radius.

glow.glow_base.name: Glow base
glow.glow_base.hint: Glow kept on blurred (out of focus) hexagons, 0..1.

glow.glow_falloff.name: Glow falloff
glow.glow_falloff.hint: Blur radius (px) at which the glow has mostly faded: sharp = in focus = glowing.

background.haze_1_radius.name: Haze 1 radius
background.haze_1_radius.hint: Haze radius x the longer image side.

background.haze_2_radius.name: Haze 2 radius
background.haze_2_radius.hint: Haze radius x the longer image side.

background.haze_3_radius.name: Haze 3 radius
background.haze_3_radius.hint: Haze radius x the longer image side.

bokeh_dust.count.name: Count
bokeh_dust.count.hint: Number of dust particles behind the focus plane.

bokeh_dust.min_blur.name: Min blur
bokeh_dust.min_blur.hint: Dust is always at least this blurred (px per 1000 px height).

sparks.field_bias.name: Field bias
sparks.field_bias.hint: 0 = anywhere, 1 = only inside the hexagon field.

game.corridor_radius.name: Corridor radius
game.corridor_radius.hint: No ambient hexagons closer than this to the flight path, units (0 = off).

game.gate_face_alpha.name: Gate face alpha
game.gate_face_alpha.hint: How solid the gate walls look (0..255).

game.gate_rim_colour.name: Gate rim colour
game.gate_rim_colour.hint: Rim of the gate wall hexagons.

game.gap_rim_colour.name: Gap rim colour
game.gap_rim_colour.hint: Rim of the hexagons around the gap.

game.gap_glow_colour.name: Gap glow colour
game.gap_glow_colour.hint: Glow of the hexagons around the gap.

performance.render_scale.name: Render scale
performance.render_scale.hint: Internal resolution x window size (frame is stretched to fit).

performance.cache_mb.name: Cache MB
performance.cache_mb.hint: Sprite cache limit; the cache is emptied when it is exceeded.

performance.threads.name: Threads
performance.threads.hint: Drawing threads. 0 = one per logical CPU.

performance.sprite_budget_ms.name: Sprite budget ms
performance.sprite_budget_ms.hint: Live view: time per frame allowed for making small sprites on the spot. Big sprites are always made by background threads; meanwhile the nearest cached sprite is scaled in, so no frame stalls.

performance.size_step.name: Size step
performance.size_step.hint: Sprite size buckets grow by this factor. Sprites are drawn at their exact size, so this only trades memory for sharpness.

performance.blur_step.name: Blur step
performance.blur_step.hint: Sprite blur buckets grow by this factor. Smaller = smoother focus changes, more sprites.

game.units: world units: hexagon radius = 1 (setting hexagon_field.hex_radius); speeds in units/s
rules: level = gates spawned in this run (0 in the menu / autopilot)
gap radius = max(1.2, max(min_gap, start_gap - gap_per_gate * level) + difficulty.gap_add)
speed = min(max_speed, start_speed + speed_per_gate * gates_passed) * difficulty.speed_mul (x boost_factor while boosting)
speed eases toward its target: speed += (target - speed) * min(1, dt * 2)
gap centre: random point in the disc of radius corridor_radius - 1.5, at most max_shift from the previous gap,
the first gate of a run is at camera z + 20 + spacing; gates are kept spawned up to camera z + far_clip + 6
passing: distance(ship, gap centre) <= gap radius - player_radius; perfect when < gap radius * perfect_fraction
points: 1 + perfect streak (if perfect), x2 while boosting; a crash costs a life and gives 1 s of protection
ship steering: towards the mouse target (mouse -1..1 * (corridor_radius - 1.5)) or by keys, at lateral_speed;
clamped to the disc of radius corridor_radius - 1.5
camera = ship: SetManualCamera(x + shake, y + shake, yaw = vx * 0.012, pitch = -vy * 0.008, roll = -vx * 0.02),
v = smoothed ship velocity (v += (dp/dt - v) * min(1, dt * 8)); shake = (random - 0.5) * shake_amount * 1.2,
shake_amount = 1 after a crash, -1.5 per second
focus distance = max(2, distance to the next gate), 12 when there is none

look_overrides.note: the game changes these engine settings at start (already included in "settings")

hud.units: u = frame height / 100; x, y in pixels of the frame (render size); text y = top of the text

font.size_note: text sizes are line heights in pixels; SDL3_ttf point size = the same number
font.shadow: black, alpha 180, offset max(1, round(size * 0.06)) px right and down
font.opacity: blinking / fading text is drawn with a copy opacity, blink = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(time * 5)

elements: crash flash: full frame, crash_flash colour with alpha 120 * flash (flash 1 -> 0 at 1.8 per second)

gap ring: ellipse around the projected next gap centre, radius = gap radius * pixels per unit, gold with alpha 70 + 110 * (1 - min(1, distance / 40)), width max(1.5, u * 0.25); only while the gate is more than 1.5 units ahead

crosshair (frame centre): circle radius r = u * 1.6, width u * 0.3, four ticks from r * 1.3 to r * 2.3; colour crosshair_far when the next gate is 15+ units away, else in_gap / outside; flickers (alpha / 3) during protection
SCORE n: (u*3, u*2), white, size u*6, left
BEST n: (u*3, u*9), soft, size u*3.4, left; PERFECT xN (streak > 1): (u*3, u*13.5), gold, size u*3.4
lives: hexagons radius u*2.2 at (W - u*4.5 - i*u*5.5, u*5.5), full: rim life_full_rim width u*0.35 filled life_full_fill; lost: life_lost width u*0.3
SPEED n (speed * 10): (u*3, H - u*8), soft, size u*3.4, left

boost bar: width W*0.24 centred, top H - u*5, height u*1.4, outline white alpha 120 width u*0.2, fill inset u*0.3 by energy (boost_bar / boost_bar_boosting); label BOOST [SPACE] centred at y = bar top - u*4, size u*2.6
message (GO!, PERFECT +n, CRASH!): centred at y = H/2 - u*18, size u*7, alpha 255 * min(1, time_left * 2), 1.2 s
menu: dark band (W/2 +- u*42, H/2 - u*40 .. H/2 + u*44) menu_band; HEXGATE title centred at H/2 - u*38, size u*14, title_blue

main menu: subtitle at H/2 - u*20 size u*3.4 soft; items PLAY / OPTIONS / EXIT at H/2 - u*8 + i*u*11; selected: gold size u*6.5 between hexagons radius u*1.6 at x = W/2 +- u*17 (fill gold alpha 90*blink); others white alpha 200 size u*5.5; best line at H/2 + u*30; help at H - u*7 size u*2.5

options: header OPTIONS at H/2 - u*22 size u*5.5; rows at H/2 - u*12 + i*u*7 (BACK + u*2), label at W/2 - u*34 size u*3.8, value right-aligned at W/2 + u*34; selected row band menu_row_selected; volume = 10 hexagons over u*26 ending u*7 before the value
pause: pause_dim over the frame, PAUSED size u*10 at H/2 - u*10, hint at H/2 + u*4 size u*4
game over: game_over_dim, GAME OVER size u*12 red at H/2 - u*22, SCORE size u*7 at H/2 - u*6, best / NEW BEST! at H/2 + u*3, hint at H/2 + u*13
FPS (option): bottom right, size u*2.8 at H - u*5, detail line size u*2.2 at H - u*8.5

camera.axes: world and camera space: x right, y down, z forward (into the screen); units: hexagon radius = hexagon_field.hex_radius
rotation: yaw (look right > 0):   x1 = d.x*cos(yaw) - d.z*sin(yaw);  z1 = d.x*sin(yaw) + d.z*cos(yaw)
pitch (look up > 0):    y2 = d.y*cos(pitch) + z1*sin(pitch); z2 = -d.y*sin(pitch) + z1*cos(pitch)
roll:                   xc = x1*cos(roll) - y2*sin(roll);   yc = x1*sin(roll) + y2*cos(roll);  zc = z2
projection: f = (H / 2) / tan(camera.field_of_view / 2)      (H = frame height in pixels)
screen x = W/2 + f * xc / zc,  screen y = H/2 + f * yc / zc,  radius in pixels = f * R / zc
nothing closer than camera.near_clip is drawn
motion_free_flight: x = camera.sway_x * sin(w * camera.sway_freq);  y = camera.sway_y * sin(w * camera.sway_freq * 0.73 + 1.3)
mouse steer: steer_yaw += (mouse_x * rad(camera.mouse_steer) - steer_yaw) * min(1, dt * camera.mouse_smooth);
steer_pitch += (-mouse_y * rad(camera.mouse_steer) * 0.6 - steer_pitch) * min(1, dt * camera.mouse_smooth)
camera.motion_game: see game.rules: the game sets x, y, yaw, pitch, roll and the focus distance itself
depth_of_field: focus = max(0.3, depth_of_field.focus_distance + depth_of_field.focus_pull * sin(w * depth_of_field.focus_pull_freq)) (or the game's focus)
blur radius px (circle of confusion) = min(depth_of_field.max_blur * H / 1000, depth_of_field.aperture * H / 100 * |zc - focus| / zc)
fade: smoothstep(e0, e1, x) = t*t*(3-2t), t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1)
fade(z) = (1 - smoothstep(fog.fog_start, fog.fog_end, z)) * smoothstep(fog.near_fade_end, fog.near_fade_start, z)
gate walls use near fade 5.0 -> 2.2 instead of the fog settings; anything with fade < 0.02 is skipped

hash: hashf(a, b, c, d) -> 0..1, all integer maths on unsigned 32 bit with wrap-around:
h = h xor (h >> 16); h = h * 0x7FEB352D; h = h xor (h >> 15); h = h * 0x846CA68B; h = h xor (h >> 16)
value_noise: noise(x, y, z, seed): xi = floor(x) ...; f = fractional part, smoothed f*f*(3-2f) per axis
trilinear blend of hashf(xi+dx, yi+dy, zi+dz, seed) for dx, dy, dz in {0, 1}
cluster(x, y, z) = 0.65 * noise(x*s, y*s, z*s, seed) + 0.35 * noise(x*s*2.1 + 17, y*s*2.1 + 5, z*s*2.1, seed + 1),  s = hexagon_field.noise_scale
mask: t(x, y) = y / s - (hexagon_field.edge_offset - hexagon_field.edge_slope * x / s)   (> 0: inside the field)
sheets: honeycomb sheets every hexagon_field.sheet_gap along z; sheet k is at z0 = k * sheet_gap
kept in range: k from floor((cam_z + near_clip - thickness - z_jitter * sheet_gap) / sheet_gap) to ceil((cam_z + far_clip) / sheet_gap)
r = hex_radius; dx = 1.5 * r * cell_gap; dy = sqrt(3) * r * cell_gap; flat-top hexagons
offset ox = hashf(k, 11, 0, seed) * dx, oy = hashf(k, 12, 0, seed) * dy
extent: Ex = far_clip * (tan(fov/2) * 2 + tan(rad(min(80, look_yaw + mouse_steer)))) + sway_x + 2r;
Ey = far_clip * (tan(fov/2) * 1.05 + tan(rad(min(80, look_pitch + mouse_steer * 0.6)))) + sway_y + 2r
cells: col from floor((-Ex - ox) / dx) to ceil((Ex - ox) / dx), row from floor((-Ey - oy) / dy) - 1 to ceil((Ey - oy) / dy)
x = ox + col * dx; y = oy + row * dy (+ dy/2 when col is odd); h[i] = hashf(col, row, k, seed * 8 + i), i = 0..6
skip when corridor_radius > 0 and x^2 + y^2 < corridor_radius^2
p = smoothstep(fade_start, fade_end, t) * density * (cluster_min + (1 - cluster_min) * smoothstep(cluster_low, cluster_high, cluster(x, y, z0)))
kept when h0 < p; otherwise a loose (stray) cell when -loose_zone < t < 0.05 and h1 < loose_chance; else skipped
z = z0 + (h2 - 0.5) * z_jitter * sheet_gap;  R = r * (1 - size_jitter * 0.7 + h3 * size_jitter)
loose cells: d = r * (0.5 + h4 * loose_drift); x -= d * 0.6; y -= d * 0.8; R *= 1 - loose_shrink * h5; z += (h6 - 0.5) * sheet_gap * 0.5
gates: a gate = honeycomb disc at depth Z with a round gap (centre GX, GY, radius GR); lattice as the sheets but without offset
cells with x^2 + y^2 > (corridor_radius + 4r)^2 are outside the disc; cells with distance to the gap centre < GR + 0.85r form the gap
cell radius 0.96r; cells closer than GR + 2.4r to the gap centre are the gap rim (sprite gate_edge), the rest gate
gates are removed once the camera is 2 units past them
dust: count = bokeh_dust.count; spawned in front of the camera at zr in [focus_distance * 1.2, far_clip] (respawn: [0.8, 1] * far_clip)
x = cam_x + (rand*2 - 1) * tan(fov/2) * 1.8 * zr; y = cam_y + (rand*2 - 1) * tan(fov/2) * zr;
accepted when rand < 0.25 + 0.75 * exp(-(t(x, y) / 0.3)^2) (30 tries)
dot = rand < dot_chance; size = rand(size_min, size_max) (x dot_size for dots); alpha = rand(alpha_min, alpha_max) (x 2.5 for dots, max 255)
respawn when zr < focus_distance * 0.8 or zr > far_clip * 1.05
drawn: alpha = alpha/255 * fade(z) * smoothstep(focus_distance*0.8, focus_distance*1.3, z); radius = f * size / z;
blur = max(circle of confusion, min_blur * H / 1000); sprite dust or dot
sparks: count = sparks.count; zr in [max(near_fade_start, focus_distance * 0.4), focus_distance * 2.5], x/y as dust;
accepted when rand < (1 - field_bias) + field_bias * smoothstep(fade_start - 0.05, fade_end + 0.1, t)
size = rand(size_min, size_max); alpha = rand(alpha_min, alpha_max); phase = rand*2pi; twinkle = rand(twinkle_min, twinkle_max);
rise = rand(rise_min, rise_max); life speed = 1 / max(0.1, rand(life_min, life_max)); life starts random (0 on respawn)
update: life += dt * life_speed; y -= rise * dt; x += cos(time * 0.7 + phase) * sway * dt; respawn when life >= 1, zr < near_clip*2 or zr > far_clip
drawn: a = alpha * sin(pi * life) * fade(z) * ((1 - twinkle_depth) + twinkle_depth * sin(time * twinkle + phase)); skip when a < 3
rp = max(0.3, f * size / z); blur = circle of confusion
blur > 2 rp: one disc radius blur, halo colour, alpha max(a * 0.05, a * (2rp / blur)^2 * 0.4)
else: disc radius rp * halo_size, halo colour, alpha a * halo_alpha; then disc radius rp, core colour, alpha a
disc: radius < 0.9 -> alpha *= radius / 0.9, radius = 0.9; coverage = clamp(radius + 0.5 - distance, 0, 1)
world.random: world cells and gate hashing are deterministic from the seed; particles and gap positions use ordinary random numbers

order: 3 hexagons of all sheets and gates, sorted far to near; for each: back face, side edges, front face
hexagon_item: front: centre and radius r projected from the cell; back: the same cell moved hexagon_field.thickness further in z, radius BR
back face (when BR > 0.3): sprite back (gate_back for gates) at the back position
side edges (BR > 0.3, r > 5 and blur < hexagon_style.side_max_blur * H / 1000): 6 lines from front corner i to back corner i,
corner = centre + radius * (cos(i*60deg), sin(i*60deg)); width max(1, r * line_width * 0.7); colour back_colour,
front face: sprite front_glow (front when the glow pass is off; gate / gate_edge for gate cells), opacity = fade(z)
occlusion: the nearest gate that is between 5.5 units and fog_start away hides hexagons behind it (z > gate z + 0.3) whose
whole sprite lies inside the projected disc (radius corridor_radius + 4r - 1.5r) and outside the projected gap (radius GR + r)
blit: sprite chosen by quantised size and blur (sprites.quantisation); scale s = r / rq (always <= 1)
sprite canvas W x W, centre c = (W - 1) / 2; the canvas pixel u maps to the screen x = cx + (u - c) * s
as a quad in pixel-centre convention: left = cx + 0.5 - W * s / 2, top = cy + 0.5 - W * s / 2, size W * s, bilinear filtering
blend: sprites and discs: premultiplied alpha, out = src + dst * (1 - src_alpha); opacity o multiplies colour and alpha
background: copy; vignette and HUD: normal (straight alpha) blending

sprites.pixels: sprite pixels are premultiplied while drawing; the atlas PNG stores straight alpha
canvas: g = glow.glow_strength * (glow.glow_base + (1 - glow.glow_base) * exp(-(bq / max(0.1, glow.glow_falloff))^2))
front_glow becomes plain front when 200 * g < 6
margin m: glow kinds: gb = rq * glow.glow_blur + bq, m = gb * 1.2 + lw * glow.glow_width + 2; others m = bq * 1.2 + lw + 2
canvas size W = 2 * (ceil(rq) + ceil(m)) + 1; centre c = (W - 1) / 2
hexagon = flat-top polygon: corner i at c + rq * (cos(i*60deg), sin(i*60deg)), i = 0..5
blur = BGRABitmap FilterBlurRadial(radius, rbFast) (a fast radial approximation of a gaussian), applied when radius > 0.3

kinds.name: front
recipe: face layer: polygon outline hexagon_style.rim_colour alpha rim_alpha, width lw, filled with face_colour alpha face_alpha
inner hexagon radius rq * inner_size, outline inner_rim_colour alpha rim_alpha * inner_alpha, width lw * 0.5
specular line corner 3 -> corner 4, specular_colour alpha rim_alpha * specular_alpha, width lw * 0.6
blur the face layer by bq

kinds.name: back
recipe: polygon outline back_colour alpha rim_alpha * back_alpha, width lw * 0.8; blur by bq

kinds.name: glow
recipe: glow layer only: polygon outline glow_colour alpha 200 * min(1, g), width lw * glow_width; blur by gb

kinds.name: dust
recipe: filled circle radius rq, bokeh_dust.dust_colour alpha 255; blur by bq (drawn with the particle alpha as opacity)

kinds.name: dot
recipe: filled circle radius rq, bokeh_dust.dot_colour alpha 255; blur by bq

kinds.name: front_glow
recipe: glow layer (as glow) first, then the face layer of front drawn over it

kinds.name: gate
recipe: front_glow with rim colour = game.gate_rim_colour, face alpha = game.gate_face_alpha, glow base 0.6

kinds.name: gate_edge
recipe: front_glow with rim colour = game.gap_rim_colour, glow colour = game.gap_glow_colour, glow strength x 1.6,
face alpha = game.gate_face_alpha, glow base 0.6

kinds.name: gate_back
recipe: back with back colour = game.gate_rim_colour and back alpha 0.5

quantisation: size buckets grow by performance.size_step: off = -floor(ln(0.5) / ln(size_step));
si = clamp(ceil(ln(max(r, 0.5)) / ln(size_step) - 1e-4) + off, 0, 255); rq = exp((si - off) * ln(size_step))
blur buckets grow by performance.blur_step: bi = 0 when blur < 0.5, else clamp(1 + round(ln(blur / 0.5) / ln(blur_step)), 1, 63);
the atlas below is a coarser sample (sizes x blurs) for programs that do not draw the recipes themselves:
pick the smallest atlas size >= r (or the largest), the nearest blur, and scale by r / rq

atlas.note: entry (x, y, w, h) is a square sprite canvas; its centre is ((w - 1) / 2, (h - 1) / 2)

recipe: fill background.base_colour (alpha 255)
for i = 1..3: radial gradient from haze_i_colour to the same colour with alpha 0,
centre (W * haze_i_x, H * haze_i_y), radius max(W, H) * haze_i_radius, drawn over (BGRABitmap gamma-corrected gradient)
made for the output size; it does not move with the camera
transparent layer; radial gradient from black alpha 0 to black alpha vignette.strength,
centre (W * centre_x, H * centre_y), radius sqrt(W^2 + H^2) * vignette.radius
then a linear gradient from black alpha vignette.shadow_alpha at (0, 0) to alpha 0 at (W * shadow_end_x, H * shadow_end_y)
drawn over the finished picture

disc.recipe: white disc, premultiplied: alpha = clamp(size / 2 - 0.5 - distance from the centre, 0, 1); 64 x 64; tinted per spark

reference_frame.note: one frame rendered by the CPU renderer (no HUD), for checking another implementation
